symbol.title: BABCS Registration
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents babcs registration behaviour in ourd/egcf/external_algorithms.py.

symbol.title: Bounded Transition Kernel
symbol.desc: The pure two-phase OIEC control layer that prepares governed actions and accepts evidence-bearing observations without executing commands or writing repository files.

symbol.title: Dimension Candidate
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents dimension candidate behaviour in ourd/oiec.py.

symbol.title: Evidence Manager
symbol.desc: The lifecycle service that creates, validates, queries, or supersedes evidence records.

symbol.title: OURD Agent
symbol.desc: The runtime coordinator that presents model reasoning as proposals while routing governed tools, candidate transactions, EON actions, evidence, and CFEL through deterministic controls.

symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents prepared transition behaviour in ourd/oiec.py.

symbol.title: Attempt Key
symbol.desc: The pre-action identity binding an exact snapshot, EON action, relevant evidence state, boundary state, and dimension state for no-blind-retry enforcement.

symbol.title: Authority Manifest
symbol.desc: The human-authored declaration of which workspace snapshot, paths, commands, capabilities, evidence rules, risks, and retry limits may be used.

symbol.title: Boundary State
symbol.desc: The signed fixed-point projection of semantic scope, authority patterns, governance patterns, experimental dimensions, and boundary uncertainty for one exact source snapshot.

symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents capability grant behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Capability Spec
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents capability spec behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Claim Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for claim.

symbol.title: Collision Record
symbol.desc: The durable CFEL record of a significant mismatch between expectation and observation.

symbol.title: Command Definition
symbol.desc: The canonical schema-backed definition of command behaviour.

symbol.title: Command Invocation
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents command invocation behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Compiled Workflow

symbol.title: Decision Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for decision.

symbol.title: Dimension Budget
symbol.desc: The finite deterministic limits and selected experimental dimensions that constrain active OIEC complexity without enlarging authority.

symbol.title: EON Action
symbol.desc: The exact action object that binds authority, source state, candidate content, target paths, command arguments, evidence, risk, expiry, and use limits.

symbol.title: Evidence Artifact
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents evidence artifact behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Evidence Requirement
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents evidence requirement behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Execution Plan
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents execution plan behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Execution Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for execution.

symbol.title: Failure Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for failure.

symbol.title: Finite Evidence State
symbol.desc: The action-scoped bitmask and quality projection that keeps active evidence finite while leaving the durable evidence registry append-only.

symbol.title: Gate Decision
symbol.desc: The deterministic evidence-gate result that records whether an exact EON action may proceed and why.

symbol.title: Governance Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for governance.

symbol.title: Intent Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for intent.

symbol.title: Invariant Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for invariant.

symbol.title: Progress Certificate
symbol.desc: The deterministic proof that an observed transition gained relevant evidence, improved a goal or risk measure, resolved boundary uncertainty, ran a discriminating experiment, or stopped terminally.

symbol.title: Qualification Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for qualification.

symbol.title: Record Mixin
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents record mixin behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Rollback Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for rollback.

symbol.title: Runtime State
symbol.desc: The rebuildable current-state projection used to coordinate unresolved transactions, actions, collisions, and execution history.

symbol.title: Selection Decision
symbol.desc: A typed decision object that records the basis and consequence of selection.

symbol.title: Supersedence Record
symbol.desc: A typed canonical record that preserves the identity, provenance, and lifecycle facts for supersedence.

symbol.title: Transaction Record
symbol.desc: The durable record of a staged or applied file transaction, including original and candidate content hashes needed for verification and rollback.

symbol.title: Workflow Definition
symbol.desc: The canonical schema-backed definition of workflow behaviour.

symbol.title: Workflow Node
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents workflow node behaviour in ourd/egcf/models.py.

symbol.title: Algorithm Registry
symbol.desc: The canonical registry that qualifies, indexes, and resolves algorithm definitions.

symbol.title: Assurance Manager
symbol.desc: The lifecycle service that creates, validates, queries, or supersedes assurance records.

symbol.title: Command Registry
symbol.desc: The canonical registry that qualifies, indexes, and resolves command definitions.

symbol.title: Decision Manager
symbol.desc: The lifecycle service that creates, validates, queries, or supersedes decision records.

symbol.title: Domain Pack
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents domain pack behaviour in ourd/egcf/domains.py.

symbol.title: Domain Pack Registry
symbol.desc: The canonical registry that qualifies, indexes, and resolves domain pack definitions.

symbol.title: Experiment Designer
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents experiment designer behaviour in ourd/egcf/experiments.py.

symbol.title: IEPS
symbol.desc: The evidence-production service for coverage, counterexamples, mutation, shrinking, uniqueness, qualification, and gates.

symbol.title: Invariant Manager
symbol.desc: The lifecycle service that creates, validates, queries, or supersedes invariant records.

symbol.title: Selection Engine
symbol.desc: The service that chooses a context-qualified algorithm using declared qualification strength and deterministic selection order.

symbol.title: Simulation Engine
symbol.desc: The deterministic orchestration service for simulation operations.

symbol.title: Agent Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into agent behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Codex Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into codex behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: EON Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into eon behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Engine Control Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into engine control behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Executor Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into executor behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: MCP Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into mcp behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Model Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into model behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Semantic Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into semantic behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Shell Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into shell behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Simulation Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into simulation behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Skill Adapter
symbol.desc: A controlled execution bridge that translates an authorized EGCF plan node into skill behaviour without transferring authority.

symbol.title: Approval Manager
symbol.desc: The lifecycle service that creates, validates, queries, or supersedes approval records.

symbol.title: Capability Resolver
symbol.desc: The service that intersects capability requirements, grants, facets, scope, expiry, and use limits to compute effective authority.

symbol.title: Command Decision
symbol.desc: A typed decision object that records the basis and consequence of command.

symbol.title: Policy Engine
symbol.desc: The deterministic evaluator for risk floors, evidence sufficiency, authority, approvals, commands, targets, and execution permission.

symbol.title: Transaction Manager
symbol.desc: The service that stages immutable candidates, applies them atomically where possible, verifies results, and restores original bytes during rollback.

symbol.title: CFEL: Collision, Failure, Evidence, and Learning Feedback
symbol.desc: CFEL records the difference between expectation and observation, blocks unchanged blind retries, and turns failure into bounded evidence for a revised model.

symbol.title: EON: Exact Governed Action Boundary
symbol.desc: EON binds a proposed operation to exact authority, source state, targets, candidate content, commands, tests, invariants, risk, expiry, and use limits.

symbol.title: Evidence Gate
symbol.desc: The evidence gate compares the proposed action's declared requirements with current artifacts, authority, approval, risk, and invariants.

symbol.title: Governed Action
symbol.desc: A governed action is the actual mutation or command execution performed only after the exact candidate passes its deterministic gate.

symbol.title: HRT: Human-Readable Task Interpretation
symbol.desc: HRT turns a human request into explicit claims, assumptions, ambiguities, scope, exclusions, and provenance before deeper reasoning begins.

symbol.title: IEPS: Invariant and Evidence Production System
symbol.desc: IEPS produces coverage, oracles, counterexamples, uniqueness checks, mutations, shrinking, qualification, and evidence gates.

symbol.title: IURM: Invariant-Uncertainty-Response Modeling
symbol.desc: IURM identifies dimensions, baselines, controlled variations, interactions, sensitivity, and minimum viable designs.

symbol.title: OURD: Object-Universe-Relation-Dependency Modeling
symbol.desc: OURD builds the relational map of the problem: objects, boundaries, dependencies, goals, impacts, exclusions, and unresolved relations.

symbol.title: Model Provider
symbol.desc: The bounded model-provider interface for model requests and responses.

symbol.title: Open AI Responses Provider
symbol.desc: The bounded provider adapter for OpenAI-compatible Responses APIs, including context estimation, retries, tool-call normalization, and cancellation points.

symbol.title: Provider Config
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents provider config behaviour in ourd/providers/base.py.

symbol.title: Artifact Store
symbol.desc: The content-addressed store for larger evidence and execution artifacts.

symbol.title: EGCF Store
symbol.desc: The combined persistence boundary for canonical objects, artifacts, events, and rebuildable query projections.

symbol.title: Event Store
symbol.desc: The append-only, SHA-256-chained event ledger used as durable provenance and replay history.

symbol.title: Object Store
symbol.desc: The content-addressed canonical store for immutable EGCF records.

symbol.title: State Store
symbol.desc: The rebuildable state projection derived from canonical events.

symbol.title: Workspace Lock
symbol.desc: The exclusive writer lock that prevents concurrent mutation and exposes unresolved transaction state.

symbol.title: Agent Cancelled Error
symbol.desc: Raised when an interactive agent turn is cooperatively stopped.

symbol.title: Approval Error
symbol.desc: Raised when execution lacks a current exact-plan approval.

symbol.title: Capability Error
symbol.desc: Raised when effective authority does not cover requirements.

symbol.title: Compilation Error
symbol.desc: Raised when a semantic command or workflow cannot compile safely.

symbol.title: Context Budget Error
symbol.desc: Raised when a provider request exceeds the configured context budget.

symbol.title: EGCF Error
symbol.desc: Base EGCF refusal or consistency error.

symbol.title: Policy Error
symbol.desc: Raised when a deterministic governance or execution policy blocks work.

symbol.title: Provider Error
symbol.desc: Raised when a model provider cannot satisfy the requested protocol.

symbol.title: Qualification Error
symbol.desc: Raised when no context-qualified algorithm is available.

symbol.title: Schema Error
symbol.desc: Raised when a typed EGCF object is invalid.

symbol.title: State Error
symbol.desc: Raised when persisted evidence or state cannot be trusted.

symbol.title: Budget
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents budget behaviour in ourd/egcf/context.py.

symbol.title: Command Context
symbol.desc: The shared scope, evidence, approval, risk, rollback, budget, timeout, trace, simulation, and strictness contract inherited by semantic commands.

symbol.title: EGCF Engine
symbol.desc: The high-level semantic command engine that coordinates catalogs, stores, registries, compilation, evidence, approval, simulation, and execution adapters.

symbol.title: EGCF: Evidence-Governed Command Fabric
symbol.desc: EGCF compiles semantic engineering intent into typed, content-addressed workflow plans governed by capabilities, evidence, approvals, and exact execution adapters.

symbol.title: Lifecycle
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents lifecycle behaviour in ourd/egcf/lifecycle.py.

symbol.title: Semantic Handlers
symbol.desc: A public OURD runtime concept that owns or represents semantic handlers behaviour in ourd/egcf/handlers.py.

symbol.title: Workflow Compiler
symbol.desc: The compiler that turns semantic commands and workflow definitions into typed plans while applying schema, capability, algorithm, evidence, and refusal rules.
